newsitem.title: USA: US STOCK INDEX FUTURES TRIM GAINS, AS T-BONDS DIP.
newsitem.headline: US STOCK INDEX FUTURES TRIM GAINS, AS T-BONDS DIP.

text.p: Aug 7 - U.S. stock index futures trimmed gains, as U.S. T-bond futures dipped to session lows. Sept S&Ps broke down 2.00 pts in thin volume and are now trading at 964.40. Fair value for Sept is at 4.37 pts to cash, with arbitrage buy programs at a 5.50 premium and arbitrage sell programs 3.50 over. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk, 312-408-8750))
